sourceChecks.sourceText: Of Heman, the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-Ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth.
sourceChecks.previousContext: Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied in giving thanks and praising the LORD with the harp.
sourceChecks.nextContext: All these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

sourceChecks.sourceText: the ninth to Mattaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
sourceChecks.previousContext: the eighth to Jeshaiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
sourceChecks.nextContext: the tenth to Shimei, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
